liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Darkness Jam** (2 reviews): The Darkness Jam follows Goin' Down the Road, which the reviewer enjoys; Reviewer singles out the Darkness Jam as nice [5][8]
- **Truckin'** (1 review): A goofy Looney Tunes tease comes at the start of Truckin' [6]
- **Brokedown Palace** (1 review): Brokedown Palace stands out, with good harmonies [11]
- **The Other One** (1 review): Reviewer calls this Other One especially hot, long and dreamy [3]
- **Goin' Down the Road Feeling Bad** (1 review): One of the more clearly audible 1970 versions of this song [5]
- **Not Fade Away** (1 review): The Not Fade Away, Goin' Down the Road, Not Fade Away sequence has interesting jamming [7]
- **Good Lovin'** (1 review): Pig's powerful, apparently ad-libbed Good Lovin' stands out in the show's back half [3]

## Setlist highlights

- **Darkness Jam**: rare: 4 archived performances [12]
- **St Stephen Jam**: rare: 5 archived performances [12]

## The recordings

- **gd70-12-12.sbd.clugston.5985.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 24 songs; 120 min; rated 3.78/5 by 9 [1]. Said about its sound: Soundboard has slight hiss and a few odd splices, otherwise fine; Good soundboard, about A-, with a few harsh cuts, notably in The Other One, and no audience patches; Sound is decent [3][4][6][7][8][9][11]
- **gd1970-12-12.151894.aud.partial.taback.flac16**: audience recording; 13 songs; 53 min [2]

## Around the show

- Good soundboards from fall and December 1970 are rare, which makes this one valuable [4]
- Band came out ready after about two weeks off from a very busy 1970 [11]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd70-12-12.sbd.clugston.5985.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Scott Clugston; source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Master soundboard reel to cassette to DAT to CDR; mastered and converted to SHN by Scott Clugston [1]
- **gd1970-12-12.151894.aud.partial.taback.flac16**: taped by Gene Taback; transferred by David Minches; source: Master Audience Cassette; Sony TC-124 with Sony Stereo Mic [2]. Also: Partial audience recording, labeled taback, circulating as FLAC 16-bit [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Santa Rosa Fairgrounds, Poster, Dec '70](https://www.dead.net/archives/1970/artwork/santa-rosa-fairgrounds-poster-dec-70) [13]
